record.question: Who is known as 'The Iron Lady' from Northeast, crusading against the draconian law of AFSPA
record.explanation: Answer A: Irom Sharmila. Irom Sharmila is the northeastern activist associated with the long hunger strike against AFSPA, conventionally called the Iron Lady of Manipur. A UN human-rights mission report discusses her AFSPA protest. A gives her actual name; Iron Sharmila in B is a misspelling, not another documented person. Historical/source note: Her actual given name is Irom, not the epithet Iron; source description of the law as draconian is editorial wording. Reference: https://uhri.ohchr.org/Document/File/593c6446-26d9-4d86-8d1c-1f4eadf50092/C11331A7-1B66-4BC3-A53D-EE71CFCAB3AE. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
